Delta A: Tidal stretch: the difference in gravity from head to feet
M: Mass of the hole or the lens
b: Impact parameter: how far from the mass the light passes
b_c: Critical impact parameter: light passing closer falls in
r: Distance from the center of the hole
t_E: Einstein crossing time: the time to cross one Einstein radius
u: Source offset from the lens, in Einstein radii
u_0: Offset at closest approach, in Einstein radii
v: Speed of the source across the line of sight
z: Redshift; light arrives stretched by 1 + z
